changes.text: No longer a live region by default: `.val` drops its `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, so value updates are not announced unless you pass the new `live` prop.

New `live` prop (default `false`). When set, the tile root is one `role="status"` region with `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`, so an update reads as "label value delta" rather than a bare number.

Contrast on the tile now passes WCAG AA: the `prefix` / `suffix` unit (`.small`) uses `--ss-fg-muted` instead of half-transparent text, the negative `emphasis` chip lifts its text toward `--ss-fg`, and the `deltaLabel` inside a chip inherits the chip colour.
Plain-HTML support: the `.ss-metric` styles ship in `dssoca/vanilla.css`, so the same markup can be used without Svelte. No `vanilla.js` behaviour is needed.
The loading skeleton's `@keyframes` is renamed from `skeleton-pulse` to `ss-metric-skeleton-pulse` so it is safe in a global stylesheet. No visual change.

New `trend` prop (`'positive'` | `'negative'` | `'neutral'`) colours the delta independently of the arrow `dir`, so a rising error rate can read as negative. Without it, `up` is positive and `down` is negative.

New `deltaLabel` (comparison period after the delta, e.g. "vs prev 7d"), `prefix` (leading unit such as `$`), `emphasis` (delta as a soft zero-radius sentiment chip) and `chart` (snippet below the delta, e.g. for a `Sparkline`).
New `loading` prop: sets `aria-busy` on the tile and shows `aria-hidden` skeleton bars in place of the value and delta. The pulse stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

The delta's classes are now the sentiment (`.positive` / `.negative` / `.neutral`) instead of the direction (`.up` / `.down`), and its colours come from the new `--ss-success` / `--ss-danger` tokens (were `--ss-primary` / `--ss-red`).

The delta is exposed as `role="img"` with a worded label ("increased 12% vs prev 7d") and the arrow glyph is `aria-hidden`, so colour and arrow are not the only signal. The value (`.val`) becomes a polite `role="status"` live region.
Styles moved from the global `theme.css` into the component's own scoped styles. Hand-written `.ss-metric` markup styled only by `theme.css` is no longer styled; use the component.
New `size` prop (`'sm'` | `'md'` | `'lg'`), applied as `data-size-variant` on the root. When unset it follows `componentsSize.MetricTile` from the config, then the global `sizeVariant`.
The delta carries an `aria-label` that words the direction ("up 12%"), so the arrow glyph is not the only cue for screen readers.
Root class renamed from `hub-metric` to `ss-metric`, and the tokens it reads from `--hs-*` to `--ss-*`.
New component: a stat tile that shows a `label`, a large `value` with an optional `suffix`, and an optional `delta` with an up or down arrow set by `dir`.
